narrative_purpose: Open the chapter on the object the whole argument turns on: a shielded stone brazier keeping a coal alive in fast-moving air that chemically resists combustion. Every feature of it is a design response to a physical problem.
subject: A close view of a small light-grey pumice stone bowl about the size of two fists, hanging from three braided leather cords attached to a riding harness. The bowl's near wall is solid stone; its far wall is pierced with a row of five small round holes. Inside sits one lump of black charcoal glowing dull orange along its cracks. A long blue-skinned Na'vi hand with four fingers steadies the rim of the bowl from above.
scene: In the air above a dim grey landscape, the dark leather straps of a riding harness and a patch of the flying creature's grey-brown hide filling the lower left, the background an out-of-focus wash of grey haze and indigo sky.
camera: Tight three-quarter close-up on the stone bowl, shallow depth of field, the background falling away into soft haze.
light: The glowing coal is the only light source in the frame, casting warm orange up onto the inside of the bowl, the underside of the hand, and the nearest strap; everything beyond that falls into cool grey shadow.
palette: Cool grey stone and deep indigo shadow across most of the frame, with a concentrated ember-orange glow inside the bowl and a narrow warm rim on the hand and cords.
style: Painterly naturalist plate, an intimate close study of a made object, patient and observational.
detail_level: Very high on the porous texture of the pumice, the pierced holes, the cracked glowing charcoal and the braided cords; background fully soft.
composition: The bowl centred and slightly low, the hand entering from the upper right, a large area of plain dark hazy background at the upper left kept clear and low-detail.
consistency_notes: A GLOWING COAL, not a flame — no fire tongues anywhere. The bowl is light grey porous pumice, solid on the near side and pierced with a row of small holes on the far side; the same bowl recurs elsewhere in the chapter. Cool grey dominant, one contained warm glow.
